name: outlook
title: Outlook
concern: The user's Microsoft account (Outlook / Microsoft 365) through Microsoft Graph: mail, calendar events, Microsoft To Do tasks, contacts, and OneDrive files.

categories.outlook: Outlook / Microsoft 365: the user's mail, calendar events, Microsoft To Do tasks, contacts, and OneDrive files.

enabled.doc: Load this pack's skills and run its bridge. Disabled by default: it needs an Entra ID client id and an authorization run first.

token.doc: Shared secret required in the X-Semif-Token header when set.

client_id.doc: Entra ID public-client app id (not a secret).

tenant.doc: Entra tenant: common | organizations | consumers | a tenant id.

default_calendar.doc: Calendar used when a request names none.

default_task_list.doc: Microsoft To Do list used when a request names none.

default_timezone.doc: IANA zone for created events/tasks whose start has no offset.
